Title: Login and identify the target product
Description / Steps: Login as a valid customer and locate the product named 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt' on the inventory page.
Expected Result: Customer reaches the inventory page and the product 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt' is displayed and identifiable by name.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Requirement is a 3-line story with no acceptance criteria. 'Identify' is undefined (visible in list? open detail page? verify price/description?). Which user/credentials is not stated. No product data (price, description, image) is given.

Title: Authentication gate before product identification
Description / Steps: Verify valid, invalid, locked-out and empty credentials, and that the inventory is not reachable without a session.
Expected Result: Only valid users reach the product list; others see a login error.
Key Gaps in Requirement: User types in scope and behavior without a session are not specified.

Title: Product details consistency
Description / Steps: Compare the product's name, price, description and image between the inventory list and its detail page.
Expected Result: Details are consistent between list and detail page for 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt'.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Requirement does not state which attributes constitute identification.

Title: Login with standard_user
Description / Steps: Open '/'. Enter username 'standard_user' and password 'secret_sauce'. Click login.
Expected Result: Redirected to /inventory.html showing the product list; no error shown.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Credentials are assumed from SauceDemo; not in the requirement.

Title: Product is displayed after login
Description / Steps: After login, view the inventory list and look for 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt'.
Expected Result: Exactly one item named 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt' is displayed with image and price ($15.99 on default catalog) and an Add to cart button.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Price/expected data not in requirement; values assume the default SauceDemo catalog.

Title: Product name is an exact match
Description / Steps: Read the item name text of the target product and compare to 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt' (case- and spacing-sensitive).
Expected Result: Name matches exactly.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Matching rule (exact vs partial) not stated.

Title: Open product detail page by clicking its name
Description / Steps: Click the 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt' name link.
Expected Result: Detail page (/inventory-item.html?id=1) opens showing the name 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt', description, price and image.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Detail view is not required by the story; assumed as a way to identify.

Title: Open product detail page by clicking its image
Description / Steps: Click the product image of 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt'.
Expected Result: Same detail page as POS-4 opens.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Same as POS-4.

Title: Back to products from the detail page
Description / Steps: On the detail page click Back to products.
Expected Result: Returns to /inventory.html with the full product list, including the target product.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Not in requirement.

Title: Identify product after sorting
Description / Steps: Sort by Name (Z to A), then Price (low to high), then Price (high to low); locate the product each time.
Expected Result: Product remains present and identifiable under every sort order; list order changes accordingly.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Sorting is not mentioned in the requirement.

Title: Add the identified product to the cart
Description / Steps: Click Add to cart on 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt'.
Expected Result: Button changes to Remove; cart badge shows 1; the cart lists the product.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Adding to cart is outside the stated scope; included as a natural follow-up.

Title: Login with wrong password
Description / Steps: Enter 'standard_user' / 'wrong_pass'. Click login.
Expected Result: Error 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in our service'; stays on login page; product not visible.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Exact error copy not in requirement.

Title: Login with unknown username
Description / Steps: Enter 'invalid_user' / 'secret_sauce'. Click login.
Expected Result: Same mismatch error; no session created.

Title: Login with locked_out_user
Description / Steps: Enter 'locked_out_user' / 'secret_sauce'. Click login.
Expected Result: Error 'Epic sadface: Sorry
Key Gaps in Requirement: this user has been locked out.'; inventory not reachable.

Title: Login with empty username
Description / Steps: Leave username blank, enter 'secret_sauce', click login.
Expected Result: Error 'Epic sadface: Username is required'.

Title: Login with empty password
Description / Steps: Enter 'standard_user', leave password blank, click login.
Expected Result: Error 'Epic sadface: Password is required'.

Title: Direct access to inventory without login
Description / Steps: In a fresh session navigate to /inventory.html.
Expected Result: Redirected to login with error that access requires login; products not shown.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Access-control behavior not specified.

Title: Direct access to product detail without login
Description / Steps: In a fresh session navigate to /inventory-item.html?id=1.
Expected Result: Access blocked and redirected to login; no product data shown.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Same as NEG-6.

Title: Non-existent product name
Description / Steps: After login search the list for a similar but wrong name, e.g. 'Sauce Labs Bolt Shirt' or 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirts'.
Expected Result: No item with that name exists; only 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt' matches exactly.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Behavior for near-matches undefined.

Title: Invalid product id on detail page
Description / Steps: After login navigate to /inventory-item.html?id=999.
Expected Result: Page shows an 'Itemus Not Found' or empty state without crash; no data for the target product is shown.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Error handling for invalid items not specified.

Title: Session ended then product page revisited
Description / Steps: Login, open inventory, logout, press browser Back.
Expected Result: Protected inventory is not accessible after logout; login page or error is shown.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Logout and session handling not in requirement.

Title: problem_user product display
Description / Steps: Login as problem_user / secret_sauce; locate 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt' and open its detail.
Expected Result: Product is listed by name, but record known defects (e.g. wrong/broken images, detail mismatch).
Key Gaps in Requirement: Expected behavior for problem_user undefined.

Title: performance_glitch_user latency
Description / Steps: Login as performance_glitch_user / secret_sauce; locate the product with auto-waiting.
Expected Result: Login and load are delayed by several seconds but product is displayed; no timeout failure.
Key Gaps in Requirement: No performance SLA stated.

Title: visual_user and error_user display
Description / Steps: Login as visual_user and error_user; locate the product.
Expected Result: Product is present; record layout or behavior differences.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Seeded accounts not mentioned in requirement.

Title: Product uniqueness
Description / Steps: Count items whose name contains 'Bolt T-Shirt' and 'T-Shirt' in the list.
Expected Result: Exactly one 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt'; other T-Shirt (Test.allTheThings()) is not confused with it.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Disambiguation from similar products is not defined.

Title: Locating by name is not position-dependent
Description / Steps: Locate the product using name-based locator across sort orders and after refresh.
Expected Result: Same product is found regardless of position.

Title: Page refresh on inventory
Description / Steps: Refresh the inventory page after login.
Expected Result: Session persists; product still displayed.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Session persistence not stated.

Title: Injection strings in login fields
Description / Steps: Enter username "' OR '1'='1" and password "<script>alert(1)</script>", click login.
Expected Result: Login rejected with the mismatch error; no script executes; no session.

Title: Username case sensitivity and whitespace
Description / Steps: Try 'Standard_User' and ' standard_user ' with 'secret_sauce'.
Expected Result: Login rejected with mismatch error (credentials are case-sensitive); record behavior for whitespace.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Credential rules undefined.

Title: Cross-browser and viewport rendering
Description / Steps: Login and locate the product in Chromium, Firefox, WebKit and at mobile viewport width.
Expected Result: Product name remains visible and not truncated in an unreadable way.
Key Gaps in Requirement: Supported browsers/devices not specified.

Title: Cart state does not affect identification
Description / Steps: With the item already in the cart, return to inventory and locate it.
Expected Result: Product is still identified by name; its button shows 'Remove'.
